heroText: Damascus works best as a base in Syria when you anchor days around Umayyad Mosque, Straight Street and Azem Palace. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Damascus International Airport handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with City centre for the easiest first Damascus stay, then compare Old Town and Waterfront when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: Damascus hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use City centre for sightseeing, Old Town for a different local base, and Waterfront or Airport area when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
rentalCars: Do not rent a car for central Damascus unless parking and traffic are part of the plan; use one mainly for regional day trips.

history.label: 15th century BC
history.text: Late Bronze Age The name of Damascus first appeared in the geographical list of Thutmose III as tjmsqw (𓍘𓄟𓈎𓅱𓈉 and 𓍘𓄟𓊃𓐰𓈎𓅱𓈉) in the 15th century BC.

history.label: 14th century BC
history.text: A number of Akkadian spellings are found in the Amarna letters, from the 14th century BC: Dimašqa (𒁲𒈦𒋡, 𒁲𒈦𒀸𒋡), and Dimašqì (𒁲𒈦𒀸𒄀).
